methodology.matching: Unique exact-normalised-label candidates only. No fuzzy suggestion is accepted automatically; ambiguous, split and mobile candidates are excluded. Label reviews do not verify geography, vote categories or population equivalence, and do not approve any production mapping.
methodology.reference: Exact 2023 valid party votes on unchanged boundaries. Advance and election-day are tested separately. The ordinary-combined reference also includes suppressed-small-booth votes; all special-vote categories are excluded.
methodology.knownPopulationCohort: 2023 votes belonging to the known historical electorate at matched venues anywhere in the current physical venue list. This measures venue-retention/missing-booth bias using known old electorate labels. It is an optimistic coverage diagnostic, not a method for assigning moved populations or proof that the current venue accepts results for this electorate.
methodology.hostLocationProxy: For comparison, assign same-roll 2023 votes at exact-matched venues to the current booth-host electorate. This deliberately tests the naive physical-location reconstruction rule, reporting imported other-electorate votes. A vote-mass ratio is not population coverage.
methodology.limitations: No current live votes are used. Ordinary-combined is a historical diagnostic, not an assertion that current XML combines advance/election-day counts. No population redistribution, special-vote imputation, new-boundary baseline or predictive accuracy is established. Māori electors share general-hosted venues, so host-location metadata alone cannot reconstruct their electorates.
methodology.decision: No additional live swing or reconstructed baseline is enabled by this report. Review matches, current result-file membership/categories, missing-venue coverage and residence-based allocation before deployment.
